docs.overviewBody: $ASS is an automated protocol on BNB Chain that converts trading activity into a basket of tokenized Asian equities. By holding $ASS, Asian bStocks are automatically accrued in your wallet — no action needed.
docs.howBody: $ASS launched via flap.sh as a Tax Token V3 paired with QQQB, with a fixed 3% buy and 3% sell tax routed to a custom on-chain vault. On a recurring automated cycle driven by the Flap Trigger Service, the protocol converts accumulated QQQB into BABAB, TSMB and SKHYB via PancakeSwap, prices them against the Atlas Oracle, and credits every eligible holder instantly — fully on-chain, with no keeper and no manual step anywhere in the pipeline.
docs.accrualBody1: There is no staking and no deadline anywhere in the protocol. Hold at least
docs.accrualBody2: and every cycle's purchased bStocks are credited to you automatically and instantly — share accounting runs on Flap's audited dividend contract, updated on every single transfer. Claim whenever you like: one transaction delivers all three bStocks straight to your wallet, and unclaimed rewards keep accruing forever.
docs.basketBody: The basket holds three Binance bStocks weighted 33.34 / 33.33 / 33.33. bStocks are backed 1:1 per Binance's published proof of collateral, and corporate actions (dividends, splits) are handled by Binance via each token's display multiplier — raw on-chain balances are unaffected.
docs.claimingBody1: Rewards accrue as basket shares — an on-chain index token (IB-ASS) backed 1:1 by the pooled bStocks and priced by live oracle NAV at every mint, so every cycle's purchases are credited proportionally and instantly with nothing to snapshot and nobody to trust.
docs.claimingBody2: When you claim, the shares burn and unwrap in the same transaction: your pro-rata BABAB, TSMB and SKHYB move directly from the pool to your wallet. You never hold the index token, claims can be made at any size at any time, and anyone can trigger a claim on a holder's behalf — entitlements are pure on-chain state.
docs.contractsBody: All contracts are verified on BscScan — read the source, follow the flows.
docs.security1: Liquidity is created and locked by the flap.sh launchpad; the tax rate is fixed at 3/3 in the token contract.
docs.security2: Swap cycles are driven by the Flap Trigger Service through an on-chain adapter that holds no user funds and supplies no amounts — every buy is bounded by on-chain TWAP pricing, slippage limits, spend caps, allowlisted routers and deadlines, and re-validated live inside every callback.
docs.security3: Purchased stocks flow directly into the basket pool that backs holder shares; pooled basket assets can never be swept by anyone, including the owner.
docs.security4: A failed swap skips safely and its budget carries forward — one asset's failure never blocks the others, and if automation ever lapses, a manual fallback can drive any cycle without touching user entitlements.
docs.risksBody: $ASS is an experimental protocol. Smart contracts can contain bugs; bStock liquidity and pricing depend on Binance-operated markets which can pause during corporate actions; token prices are volatile. Nothing here is financial advice — read the contracts and decide for yourself.
docs.faq1Q: Do I need to claim anything?
docs.faq1A: Accrual is automatic and never expires — your rewards are credited on-chain every cycle whether you claim or not. Claiming just moves them to your wallet: one transaction, all three bStocks, whenever you choose.
docs.faq2A: Eligibility requires holding at least 10,000 $ASS. Balances below the threshold are not tracked for accrual.
docs.faq3Q: Where do the stocks come from?
docs.faq3A: Each cycle the vault's QQQB tax revenue buys BABAB, TSMB and SKHYB on PancakeSwap. Every purchase is a public transaction.
docs.faq4A: Binance-issued tokenized equities on BNB Chain, backed 1:1 per Binance's proof of collateral. They trade on-chain like any BEP-20.
docs.guideQuote: Trade with discipline. Let the strategy compound.

footer.disclosureBody: Asian Stock Strategy ($ASS) is a memecoin with a custom-built on-chain protocol that uses trading-tax revenue to acquire and automatically accrue supported bStocks to eligible $ASS holders on BNB Chain.
footer.bstocksBody: bStocks are tokenized securities and are not direct shares or brokerage-held stock in the underlying companies. Holding bStocks does not make the holder a direct shareholder and does not provide direct voting, dividend, inspection or other shareholder rights. Corporate actions, including dividends, may instead be reflected through the bStocks Multiplier mechanism in accordance with the issuer's applicable terms. bStocks remain subject to their own issuer terms, eligibility requirements, market risks and jurisdictional restrictions.
footer.riskBody: $ASS is a speculative memecoin and participation involves significant risk. The protocol makes no promise or guarantee of profit, yield, appreciation or financial return. The value of $ASS, bStocks and other digital assets may fluctuate substantially and users may lose some or all of the value committed. Nothing on this website constitutes financial, investment, legal or tax advice, or a recommendation or solicitation to buy or sell any asset. Always conduct your own research and ensure participation is lawful in your jurisdiction.
